title: Azure AI - Cost visibility (Cost Management export)

panels.title: Actual cost by currency
panels.description: Actual AI cost in the selected UTC period, read from the Cost Management export. Billing-currency cost and USD cost are separate columns. Billing can be revised or delayed.

targets.query:
AiCost()
| where $__timeFilter(Date)
| summarize BillingCost = round(sum(Cost), 2), CostUsd = round(sum(CostUsd), 2) by BillingCurrency
| order by BillingCost desc

panels.title: Export data freshness
panels.description: What the export holds, not when it last ran. A growing DaysBehind means the export is stale or billing is delayed; missing days are not zero cost.

targets.query:
AiCost()
| summarize FirstChargeDate = min(Date), LatestChargeDate = max(Date), Rows = count(), Accounts = dcount(ResourceId)
| extend DaysBehind = datetime_diff('day', startofday(now()), LatestChargeDate)

panels.title: Daily actual cost by account
panels.description: Daily actual cost per Foundry or Azure OpenAI account in its billing currency. Each currency is a separate series.

targets.query:
AiCost()
| where $__timeFilter(Date)
| extend Account = strcat(tostring(split(ResourceId, '/')[-1]), ' (', BillingCurrency, ')')
| summarize Cost = sum(Cost) by Date, Account
| order by Date asc

panels.title: Cost by account
panels.description: Actual cost by account and resource group for the selected period.

targets.query:
AiCost()
| where $__timeFilter(Date)
| summarize BillingCost = round(sum(Cost), 2), CostUsd = round(sum(CostUsd), 2)
    by Account = tostring(split(ResourceId, '/')[-1]), ResourceGroupName, BillingCurrency
| order by BillingCost desc

panels.title: Cost by meter
panels.description: Actual cost and quantity by meter, which separates input, output and provisioned charges.

targets.query:
AiCost()
| where $__timeFilter(Date)
| summarize BillingCost = round(sum(Cost), 2), CostUsd = round(sum(CostUsd), 2), Quantity = round(sum(Quantity), 2)
    by MeterCategory, MeterSubCategory, MeterName, UnitOfMeasure, BillingCurrency
| order by BillingCost desc

description: Actual cost of Azure AI resources from a Cost Management export read by Azure Data Explorer. The export covers one subscription and begins at deployment. No data can mean the export has not run yet, not zero cost.
